The EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) Model for Modern Search

Moving beyond keyword density into knowledge graph triples. How structuring content as Entity-Attribute-Value triples establishes defensible topical authority for semantic search engines.

2026-10-02 10 min read By Bibek Khatiwada
Key Engineering Takeaways
  • Search engines evaluate entities and their relationships, not just ungrounded keywords.
  • Structuring content into explicit triplets (Subject -> Predicate -> Object) powers clear extraction by LLMs and Google Knowledge Graph.
  • EAV modeling prevents internal content cannibalization by maintaining strict entity scopes across pillar-cluster networks.

Overview & Core Concept

Moving beyond keyword density into knowledge graph triples. How structuring content as Entity-Attribute-Value triples establishes defensible topical authority for semantic search engines.

Modern search engines like Google and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity) evaluate web content not as isolated keywords, but as interconnected entity nodes inside a structured knowledge graph.

Technical Mechanics

To ensure content is properly extracted, indexed, and cited, search engineering must align with machine-readable representations.

  • Structured Entity Grounding: Explicit schema.org JSON-LD definitions connecting Subject, Predicate, and Object triples.
  • Machine-Readable Endpoints: Deploying /llms.txt files that expose canonical markdown links for AI web crawlers.
  • Crawl & Rendering Hygiene: Consolidating thin or redundant URLs to maintain high domain threshold values.

Implementation & Code Example

eav_triple_generator.py 
# Entity-Attribute-Value (EAV) Knowledge Graph Triple Structurer
eav_triplets = [
    {"subject": "The EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) Model for Modern Search", "predicate": "hasCategory", "object": "Semantic Architecture"},
    {"subject": "The EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) Model for Modern Search", "predicate": "author", "object": "Bibek Khatiwada"},
    {"subject": "The EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) Model for Modern Search", "predicate": "targetEngine", "object": "Google Knowledge Graph & LLM Retrieval"}
]
print(eav_triplets)

Summary & Strategic Value

By shifting from legacy keyword targeting to structured entity modeling, brands build defensible search authority that survives Google core updates and excels in AI answer engines.
